source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (angle: pullbacks in the day trend): the owner's VWAP pullback (a candle touches the 09:30 session VWAP, the next candle is a displacement away from it in the VWAP's 30-minute direction) read on 15-MINUTE candles with a 35-point stop at 1:1.5, instead of 1-minute candles at 25 / 38. Why it should pay: on 15-minute candles a touch of VWAP is a real pullback to the session's average price and an engulfing candle away from it is the session's side taking control back; on 1-minute candles the same shape is a few ticks of noise. Who loses: the traders who sold the touch of VWAP on an up day (bought it on a down day) expecting the day to turn, trapped by the engulfing candle.

entry.words: NQ 15-minute candles, 09:35-15:00 ET. When the previous 15-minute candle touched the session VWAP (anchored 09:30; its low at or under it and its high at or over it) and the next candle is a displacement AWAY from the VWAP (body larger than the previous body, the previous candle the opposite colour, close beyond the previous candle's wick), in the direction the VWAP has moved over the last 30 minutes (longs only while the VWAP is above its value 30 minutes ago and the close is above it; shorts the mirror), enter at the close by market order. Stop 35 points, target 52.5 points (1:1.5). One position at a time, up to three trades a day, flat 15:58.
